768794a7-cdc9-4365-b767-4c70fefc3fb2.headline: They took the map. We took the loss.
768794a7-cdc9-4365-b767-4c70fefc3fb2.team: The enemy took every Fangtooth and Prime objective recorded, then dismantled our structures. Our winning skirmishes produced no quick objective return. We could win exchanges, but the enemy kept winning the map.

focus.title: Give the next fight a purpose
focus.action: Before the next objective contest, name the target, the player covering the approach, and the retreat condition. Check afterward whether those assignments happened, not just whether the team got kills.

perPlayer.16f28434-561f-4f23-9454-40321f4a1ef3: Wukong brought strong damage and cleared enemy wards with sentry. Keep that denial. Before sweeping for a gank, call the target lane and confirm the laner can follow; before an objective, call the setup and whether the team is contesting or trading. Give the team a plan to respond to, not a fucking guessing game.
perPlayer.7c8ab99c-31c5-4ea5-a6fa-e0d6417c3f1b: Revenant kept the farm and deaths under control, but hero damage fell below his usual output on the hero. A tidy score does not finish the carry job. Keep the discipline; in the next safe firing window, focus on landing the remaining shots before reloading, then reposition instead of forcing a dangerous finish.
perPlayer.a0c393cc-1437-4bdc-8168-64676ce2166c: Scarlett placed plenty of wards and kept deaths low, but recorded no objective damage. Before returning to lane near the next contest, cover a safe objective approach if a ward is available, then prepare the wave so a rotation costs less. Give the team a usable route; chasing a higher ward total is not the assignment.
perPlayer.10edbf65-457d-48d0-9151-9df5b4fcb40a: Gideon had the team's most deaths, including one before the late structure losses. For the next contest, hold the escape until the threat is accounted for and agree on a retreat call with Steel before committing. Keep contributing damage, but do not let owning the recommended core become a fucking permission slip to overcommit.
perPlayer.a412baf3-dd17-4f89-8ecf-9d0704f3a79e: Steel led mitigation and assists. Keep enabling the team. When the next gank or objective call comes, confirm whether Steel is engaging or holding control to peel, and coordinate the follow-up. Tainted Guard applies healing reduction to an enemy that basic-attacks its wearer; owning it does not mean every enemy being healed is covered.

25.call: Gideon died to Crunch. Two Inner Towers and an Inhibitor fell afterward; event timing alone does not establish that the death caused those losses.

31.call: The final kill sequence ended 1-2 immediately before the Core fell. Kill credits do not establish who was present.

10.7.call: Enemy Fangtooth was taken before the kill sequence began; the subsequent sequence ended 1-4.

768794a7-cdc9-4365-b767-4c70fefc3fb2.lossReflection: The stronger alternative was to set up before the next objective. Send the nearby laner to prepare the wave and cover a safe approach, have Wukong communicate the gank or objective plan before sweeping, and confirm who can follow. If the approach is unsafe, call a reachable trade or defend together. Winning a skirmish is not a fucking shopping receipt for an objective; someone still has to call what is safely available.
